_comment: The family contracts (D0): what each generator family is for, one row per maker in generate_exercises.py.
Read by the generator (catalog_entry stamps targetSkills, role and drill.generator from the row), by the
physical gate the build runs on every item, and by tools/content/tests (the measured-demand, physical, role,
assessment and naming tests). family_contracts.py documents every field and the four gates.
target.primary: the first rule whose `when` matches the item's recipe (drill.params plus hands) names its
primary skill, from vocabulary v0 (content/curriculum/vocabulary/skills.json); none matching is 'not judged
by the app', with the candidate recorded under notJudged for the vocabulary review. No skill was added (the
six conditions: the entry records the one candidate that came closest). Secondary skills are written after
the primary only when the primary is judged.
requires / forbids / overconcentration: measured, never declared. Checked against what the app's detectors
found in the generated MusicXML (tools/content/demands.py). A threshold is a count, or [per, n]: at least n
per bar, note or step. Each threshold's reason is beside it, and none is universal.
assumes: demands the family carries and accepts, as prerequisites of its material; the rung check reads
every measured demand against the rung listing the item, assumed or not.
physical: maxSpan (one hand at once), maxRate (the fastest strikes a second in one hand that the recipe writes
at its stated tempo: raising it is a contract change), leaps (declared moves of the hand beyond an octave, with
the time each needs), repeatedNotes (the solution to a fast repeat), fingering (printed: 'where-sourced',
'printed' or 'none'; source: the keys of `sources`, or null; fingeringVerified is never true without one).
roles: relative to the primary target skill (design §7). A new seed is never transfer.
promise: drill or music; a music family is marked unheard until a person hears it (heard: false).
version: the generator version for the family's recipe; it changes when the recipe's music changes (G21).
